title: Company Engineering Blogs
summary: Ongoing reading, and prep for a specific company
body:
# Company Engineering Blogs

> Architectures for companies you are interviewing with.
>
> **Questions you encounter might be from the same domain.**

That second line is the reason this is a **✔ for every timeline**, including the short one. Reading
a few posts from your target company's blog is the highest-leverage hour of prep available.
